reviewer: pull-service.lisp:229-252: the (error (e) ...) arm wraps the non-octet-envelope fnn-fault (237-238) and everything before fnn-write-all, and turns all of them into fnn-indeterminate. fnn-pull-worker-guarded (552-554) then fences the node (exit 3) where a pre-write failure is a definite fault (exit 4). This misclassifies the outcome, but it is conservative, and it is reachable only through an ACL2 contract break or the developer cut selector.
scenario: ACL2 returns a non-octet envelope, or the developer selector is malformed (fnn-pull-test-cut faults). Nothing has been written. The handler still converts the fault into fnn-store-indeterminate, and fnn-pull-worker-guarded fences the node with 'recovery required' (exit 3) instead of reporting a definite fault (exit 4). AGENTS.md requires uncertain, refused and faulted outcomes to stay distinct.
